measurement_note: Size is the array length n. Each workload places the minimum first, the maximum last, and fills the interior with qualifying equal values. Finding both extrema and counting the interior occurrences takes O(n) time; testing every occurrence against every array value completes all legal tiers and fails only by quadratic scaling.
